WITH d AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
),
cd_pairs (cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, sales_price_low, sales_price_high) AS (
  VALUES
    ('D', 'Primary', 100.00, 150.00),
    ('S', 'College', 50.00, 100.00),
    ('U', 'Advanced Degree', 150.00, 200.00)
),
ca_groups (ca_state, net_profit_low, net_profit_high) AS (
  VALUES
    ('NC', 100, 200),
    ('TX', 100, 200),
    ('IA', 100, 200),
    ('WI', 150, 300),
    ('WV', 150, 300),
    ('GA', 150, 300),
    ('OK', 50, 250),
    ('VA', 50, 250),
    ('KY', 50, 250)
)
SELECT
  substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20),
  avg(ws.ws_quantity),
  avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash),
  avg(wr.wr_fee)
FROM d
JOIN web_sales ws ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
JOIN reason r ON r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
JOIN cd_pairs p ON cd1.cd_marital_status = p.cd_marital_status AND cd1.cd_education_status = p.cd_education_status
JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
  AND cd2.cd_marital_status = p.cd_marital_status
  AND cd2.cd_education_status = p.cd_education_status
JOIN customer_address ca ON ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
JOIN ca_groups g ON ca.ca_state = g.ca_state
WHERE ws.ws_sales_price BETWEEN p.sales_price_low AND p.sales_price_high
  AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN g.net_profit_low AND g.net_profit_high
  AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20), avg(ws.ws_quantity), avg(wr.wr_refunded_cash), avg(wr.wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
